style.variety: natural, fluent Hindi written in Devanagari script
style.loanwords_text: Technical crypto terms keep the English word but are written in Devanagari (वॉलेट, ब्लॉकचेन, टोकन, स्मार्ट कॉन्ट्रैक्ट); never leave them in Latin script. Names of brands, products, organisations and protected terms stay in Latin script (Zcash, Zkool, Zenith).
writing_rules: Address the reader with the formal आप everywhere, in tutorials and technical pages alike.
Use the same Devanagari spelling of a kept English term in headings, menus and body text; never switch between Latin and Devanagari for the same term.
Do not add English plural endings to borrowed words: वॉलेट, मेमो, टॉप-अप, ट्यूटोरियल, डेवलपर (not वॉलेट्स, मेमोज़).
Titles and menu labels use a noun, not the infinitive with करना: Zcash का उपयोग, not Zcash का उपयोग करना.
For a quotation inside a quotation use ‘ ’.
Technical abbreviations and acronyms (ZEC, ZIP, URL, SDK, API) have no full stops.
Never put English in brackets inside a Markdown link label.

changelog.summary: Imported from the runner's hand-written prompt_head_hi.txt: language variety, loanword rule and the node rendering, approved by the steward as legacy prompt-head rules.

Native review by @AnirudhSingh07 (Zcash India), PR #2653: glossary (62 terms) and menus, with his thread answers (https://github.com/ZecHub/zechub/pull/2653#issuecomment-6797111379, https://github.com/ZecHub/zechub/pull/2653#issuecomment-6834057668). Kept English technical terms are written in Devanagari, no English plural endings, nouns for menu titles, formal आप, western digits, “ ” quotes. Steward alignments: tools → उपकरण and treasury → कोष to match his menu answers; one form per menu label for top menu and sidebar.
